### Brief Reasoning

- **[id 190]**: 3 hours = 180 minutes. Total peaches = $180 \times 2 = 360$.
- **[id 191]**: 10 ducks require $10 \times 3.5 = 35$ pounds per week. Per day: $35 / 7 = 5$ pounds.
- **[id 192]**: Net increase is $10 - 2 = 8$ trees per year. After 10 years: $50 + (10 \times 8) = 130$ trees. With 30% dying, $130 \times 0.70 = 91$ trees remain.
- **[id 193]**: Started with 18 pink. 6 turned white, leaving 12 pink and 6 white. 18 more pink added: 30 pink, 6 white. Difference: $30 - 6 = 24$.
- **[id 194]**: 5 crayons cost $5 \times \$2 = \$10$. Change: $\$20 - \$10 = 10$.
- **[id 195]**: One pen costs $\$1.20 + \$0.30 = \$1.50$. 8 pens cost $8 \times \$1.50 = 12$.
- **[id 196]**: Distributed carrots used: $40 \times 2 = 80$ pounds. Unused: $200 - 80 = 120$ pounds.
- **[id 197]**: Adults = $8417 + 9092 = 17509$. Children = $23786 - 17509 = 6277$.
- **[id 198]**: Initial = 20. Month 1 = $3 \times 20 = 60$. Month 2 = $60 - 20 = 40$. Month 3 = $2 \times (60 + 40) = 200$. Total = $20 + 60 + 40 + 200 = 320$.
- **[id 199]**: 500 sentences for Publisher A at 5 cents = 2500 cents. 500 sentences for Publisher B at 10 cents = 5000 cents. Total = $2500 + 5000 = 7500$ cents.
